worked_solution:
First, we apply the constant factor rule and take the coefficient $-\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}}=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}}\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{7}}=-\frac{\sqrt{7}}{7}$ out of the integral. Then we compute the integral of $\frac{1}{x},$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int -\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}x}\,\text{d}x & =-\frac{1}{\sqrt{7}}\int \frac{1}{x}\,\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{\sqrt{7}}{7}ln⁡|x|+C.\end{aligned}
$$
